highlights.title: 推理成本正在反过来重排模型架构的胜负条件
highlights.body: 当模型用于实时交互、Agent 执行和强化学习 rollout，推理不再只是训练后的交付环节，而是产品体验与下一轮能力提升共同依赖的基础设施。扩散语言模型的真正挑战也不只是单次生成更快，而是能否用更适合 GPU 并行的负载，同时扩大在线服务和后训练的计算空间；一旦成立，架构选择的核心指标会从训练规模转向单位成本可获得的推理量。

evidence.quote: the workload that we have at inference time in a diffusion model, it's basically very, very similar to the workload you have for training, where you're processing many tokens at the same time in parallel.

evidence.quote: inference is, again, a key bottleneck for our outpost training. And so if you have a model that scales better at inference time, then automatically you're gonna get better scaling during our output training.
